New Roof Installation Completed in Burlingame

Roof Express recently completed another professional asphalt shingle roof installation in Burlingame, CA, providing the property with a durable new roofing system and an upgraded SmartVent ventilation system.

A quality roof replacement is about more than installing new shingles. Proper underlayment, flashing, ventilation, waterproofing, and installation techniques all work together to protect the home from rain, wind, moisture, and long-term deterioration.

Our roofing team completed this Burlingame project with attention to every component of the roofing system, giving the homeowner a clean new appearance and dependable protection for years to come.

Asphalt Shingle Roof Replacement in Burlingame

Asphalt shingles remain one of the most popular roofing choices for homes throughout Burlingame and the San Francisco Bay Area. They provide an excellent combination of durability, appearance, performance, and value.

For this Burlingame roofing project, our team prepared the roof surface and installed the new asphalt shingle roofing system according to applicable installation requirements and manufacturer specifications.

A professionally installed asphalt shingle roof can provide:

Long-lasting weather protection

Excellent curb appeal

Reliable performance during Bay Area rain and wind

Multiple architectural styles and colors

Cost-effective roof replacement

Improved protection against roof leaks

Compatibility with modern attic ventilation systems

Strong long-term value for homeowners

SmartVent Roof Ventilation Installation

One of the important upgrades on this project was the installation of a SmartVent ventilation system.

Proper roof and attic ventilation is an important part of a complete roofing system. Without sufficient airflow, excessive heat and moisture can accumulate inside the attic. Over time, poor ventilation may contribute to moisture problems, deterioration of roofing components, and reduced roofing-system performance.

SmartVent is designed to help create intake ventilation while maintaining a clean roof appearance. When incorporated into a properly designed ventilation system, it helps promote continuous airflow through the attic space.

Benefits of Proper Roof Ventilation

The new ventilation system can help:

Improve attic airflow

Reduce trapped heat

Control excess attic moisture

Support longer roofing-system life

Reduce the potential for moisture-related damage

Improve overall roof performance

Provide balanced intake and exhaust ventilation when properly configured

For homes where traditional soffit ventilation is limited or difficult to install, SmartVent can be an effective solution depending on the roof design.

Why Ventilation Matters for Burlingame Homes

Burlingame's location on the San Francisco Peninsula means homes can experience changing temperatures, coastal moisture, wind, fog, and seasonal rainfall.

A roofing system should therefore do more than simply keep rain out. Proper ventilation and moisture management are important components of protecting the roof structure and attic.

When Roof Express evaluates a roof replacement in Burlingame, we look at the overall roofing system, including shingles, roof deck conditions, flashing, waterproofing, penetrations, drainage, and ventilation.

Complete Roofing System — Not Just New Shingles

A professional roof replacement involves multiple layers and details that may not be visible once the project is completed.

Our goal is to create a complete roofing assembly designed for long-term performance.

Depending on the property and project specifications, a professional asphalt shingle roof installation may include removal of the existing roofing, inspection of the roof deck, replacement of damaged wood when necessary, installation of roofing underlayment, waterproofing at vulnerable areas, new flashing components, ventilation improvements, asphalt shingles, and detailed cleanup.

Every roof is different, which is why we evaluate each property individually before recommending a roofing solution.

Professional Roofing Contractor in Burlingame, CA

Choosing the right Burlingame roofing contractor is just as important as choosing the roofing material.

Proper installation affects how well a roofing system performs over its lifetime. Details around valleys, walls, chimneys, skylights, vents, penetrations, eaves, and transitions require particular attention because these areas can be more vulnerable to water intrusion.

Roof Express provides professional roofing services for homeowners and property owners throughout Burlingame and San Mateo County.

Our services include:

Asphalt shingle roof replacement

New roof installation

Roof inspections

Roof repairs

Flat roofing

Modified bitumen roofing

Roof ventilation

SmartVent installation

Skylight installation and replacement

Flashing repairs and replacement

Plywood and roof deck replacement

Gutter and downspout installation

Emergency roof leak repair

Signs You May Need a Roof Replacement

If your Burlingame home has an older roof, it may be worth scheduling a professional inspection before leaks become more serious.

Common warning signs include missing or damaged shingles, curling shingles, excessive granule loss, deteriorated flashing, recurring roof leaks, water stains inside the home, damaged roof decking, poor attic ventilation, or a roofing system approaching the end of its expected service life.

Finding roofing problems early can help homeowners understand their options before moisture damage spreads to insulation, ceilings, walls, or structural components.

Roof Replacement vs. Roof Repair

Not every roofing problem requires a complete replacement.

If the roof is relatively young and damage is isolated, a targeted roof repair in Burlingame may be sufficient. However, when deterioration is widespread or the existing roofing system is near the end of its useful life, replacement can provide a more practical long-term solution.

Roof Express can inspect the existing roofing system and provide recommendations based on its actual condition.

Serving Burlingame and the San Francisco Bay Area

Whether you need a small roof repair, ventilation improvement, flat roof replacement, or a complete asphalt shingle roofing system, our team can evaluate your property and provide a detailed roofing proposal.
